# Virtual Engineer

> Open-source engineering automation that carries software work from an assigned
> ticket to a reviewed change. It connects issue trackers, source control, review
> systems, and AI agent engines your team already uses, and runs every cycle on
> your own infrastructure. Built and maintained by Savoir-faire Linux.

Virtual Engineer is not a hosted SaaS. It is a self-hosted TypeScript orchestrator
plus SQLite that polls issue trackers for tickets assigned to it, runs a coding
agent in an ephemeral OpenShell sandbox, opens a change for review, answers
reviewer feedback with follow-up commits, and closes the task once merged.

## Installation

The installer is a thin proxy that always fetches the current installer from the
upstream repository. It requires a POSIX shell with `curl`, and Node.js on the
target host.

```sh
curl -fsSL https://virtual-engineer.dev/install.sh | bash
```

Source and issue tracker:

- [Source repository](https://github.com/savoirfairelinux/virtual-engineer)
- [Installation documentation](https://virtual-engineer.dev/documentation.html#/start)

## Endpoints

This website is a static marketing and documentation site. There is no hosted
API, no MCP endpoint, and no paid endpoint — the product runs on infrastructure
you control.

| Path | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `/install.sh` | Shell installer proxy (text/x-shellscript) |
| `/llms.txt` | This file |
| `/llms-full.txt` | Full concatenated text of all pages on this site |
| `/agents.txt` | Agent access policy for this site |
| `/sitemap.xml` | XML sitemap |
| `/robots.txt` | Crawler directives |
| `/feed.xml` | RSS feed of site updates |
| `/.well-known/agent-card.json` | A2A agent card |

Human-readable pages:

- [Home](https://virtual-engineer.dev/) — product overview, pipeline, and features
- [Documentation](https://virtual-engineer.dev/documentation.html) — installation, configuration, and operations
- [Integrations](https://virtual-engineer.dev/integrations.html) — supported trackers, review systems, and agent engines
- [Security](https://virtual-engineer.dev/security.html) — sandbox model, credentials, and audit trail
- [About us](https://virtual-engineer.dev/about.html) — project governance, license, and maintainer

## Authentication

None. Everything on this site is public and requires no credentials. The
installer is served over HTTPS without authentication and downloads its payload
from `raw.githubusercontent.com`.

## Examples

Check that the installer is reachable before running it:

```sh
curl -fsSI https://virtual-engineer.dev/install.sh
```

Install and run the orchestrator on your own host:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://virtual-engineer.dev/install.sh | bash
```

Read the documentation as plain text without scraping HTML:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://virtual-engineer.dev/llms-full.txt
```

## Supported integrations

Issue trackers: GitHub Issues, GitLab, Redmine.

Change review: GitHub Pull Requests, GitLab Merge Requests, Gerrit.

Agent engines: GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Aider, Goose, Codex, Gemini CLI,
OpenCode, Cursor.

## Operations

- Runtime: Node.js orchestrator with SQLite storage, self-hosted.
- Sandboxing: every cycle runs in an ephemeral OpenShell sandbox under
  deny-by-default runtime policies; push credentials stay host-side.
- Audit: every state transition is recorded, alongside model usage and cost.
- Licence: GPL-3.0-only.
